title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Associate R&D HMI SCADA Application Engineer-India Development centre

links. They operate on very high standard application software developed by Hitachi Energy.
  
  
As the system is continuously evolving, the Station Operating and Monitoring System (SOM) is becoming
  
  
more complex and customized. It requires a great deal of design, testing & verification of HMI, SCADA, Gateway
  
  
and network areas.
  
  
We are looking for a skilled and motivated engineer to join our team of R&D Engineers.
  
  
A person interested in the field HMI/SCADA application development and contribute towards global R&D projects.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* You will design, develop and verify the HMI application for FACTS PQ Control and Protection System on
* Substation level based on Micro SCADA.
* You will design and verify Hitachi RTU based Gateway solution for various FACTS applications.
* To support the design of communication network by preparing related documentation to support the network
* architecture.
* You will need good knowledge of configuration and mappings databases on the IET600 Engineering tool and on the quality process connected with the project execution, continuous improvement program.
* You will be contributing to Configuration of Engineering workstations, Network switches, GPS, KVM, GOOSE.
* To set up and test the various FACTs application for developed base solution involving the overall system
* testing.

* You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Required bachelor’s degree in electrical and electronics engineering with atleast 4years of experience in substation Automation engineering for station control system based on Micro SCADA X, Hitachi RTU communication gateways and substation automation products.
* Knowledge with industrial data transfer protocols such as IEC 61850, DNP3, IEC101/104, and OPC UA.
* Knowledge of Engineering tool IET600, SCIL coding.

title: Implementation Associate
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Implementation Associate builds, tests, delivers, maintains, and supports healthcare integrations for athenahealth clients. The role manages a high-volume portfolio of new interface builds and modifications to existing interfaces; coordinates technical, functional, and quality requirements; resolves connectivity and electronic data interchange issues; and communicates project status, risks, and timelines to clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders. The Associate applies advanced knowledge of athenahealth and other healthcare products, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration to improve delivery efficiency and expand athenahealth’s interoperability network. The ideal candidate can also support people management and team coordination. This position reports to the Operations Manager in Chennai, India.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Implementation team supports client interoperability by delivering reliable interfaces and improving the workflows used to implement and maintain them. The team works closely with interface vendors, clients, and athenahealth’s US-based Onboarding Managers, Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Program Managers (IPMs), Customer Support Center (CSC), Product, and Development teams.
  
  
Team members operate across geographies and manage competing priorities in a collaborative, Agile, and Lean-oriented environment. Success requires proactive communication, careful listening, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to translate business problems and use cases into practical technical solutions or workarounds.
  
  
The team combines a shared commitment to improving healthcare with technical expertise across integration components, including HL7, networking protocols, VPN, SSH, SFTP, and XML. Team members apply data-driven analysis and structured problem-solving to deliver effective outcomes. Knowledge of hospital or ambulatory workflows and healthcare information systems further strengthens the team’s ability to develop practical, client-focused solutions.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Build, test, deliver, maintain, and support integrations for new and existing client interfaces.
* Manage a high volume of projects and tasks with competing priorities, maintaining clear ownership, accurate documentation, and timely delivery.
* Partner with the Interface Development team to customize integrations and incorporate technical, functional, and quality-assurance requirements.
* Communicate integration status, risks, dependencies, and timelines to clients, vendors, and athenahealth stakeholders.
* Analyze and resolve issues involving connectivity, electronic data interchange, HL7 messaging, and related integration components.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers, Program Managers, Product, Development, Customer Support Center teams, and other partners to ensure successful ambulatory interface engineering engagements and implementations.
* Engage clients and external stakeholders to define business problems and use cases, evaluate the advantages and limitations of available approaches, and develop appropriate technical solutions or workarounds.
* Identify workflow deficiencies and operational breakdowns, then contribute to solutions that improve outcomes, efficiency, and quality.
* Maintain effective working relationships with interface vendors, clients, and geographically distributed internal teams.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives, operational projects, and process-reengineering efforts that advance organizational capabilities.
* Optimize workflows to reduce waste and improve consistency.
* Continually assess team operations and processes and recommend measurable improvements.
* Support the training, onboarding, and mentoring of new hires.
* Support the Operations Manager with responsibilities, including communicating team performance and operational risks.
* Monitor and contribute to team performance and metrics, including routine review of daily, weekly, and monthly production and quality reports.
* Perform other duties assigned by the Operations Manager to optimize and expand operational support.

**Expected Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Science, Statistics, Management, or another quantitative field.
* 8+ years’ of overall experience in Technical Support, Operations, IT/ITES, healthcare, or a related field.
* Two to three years of project management experience, including technical projects with significant cross-functional interdependencies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with geographically dispersed teams in India and the United States.
* Demonstrated ability to explain technical issues, resolve problems, and apply logical, analytical, and data-driven decision-making.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency and a commitment to continually developing technical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate effectively, and deliver results in an Agile and Lean-oriented environment.
* Capability in people management and team leadership, including supporting the manager with delegated supervisory responsibilities and performance updates.
* Availability to work during US business hours, from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST.
* Preferred: Healthcare domain experience, including interfaces and integration engines; knowledge of HL7 standards, patient safety, HIPAA, EMR systems, and hospital or ambulatory workflows; basic SQL knowledge; and a project management certification.

title: Implementation Senior Analyst
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Implementation Senior Analyst is responsible for delivering reliable healthcare interface solutions for ambulatory clients by building, configuring, testing, implementing, and maintaining technical integrations. This role manages interface implementation activities from requirements gathering through validation and delivery, troubleshoots complex technical issues, and helps ensure solutions are completed accurately and on schedule. The position requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, together with experience in healthcare data exchange technologies such as Health Level Seven (HL7), interface engines, networking protocols, Virtual Private Network (VPN) connections, Secure Shell (SSH), Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP), and Extensible Markup Language (XML). Working closely with clients, vendors, internal stakeholders, and teams across India and the United States, the Implementation Senior Analyst helps resolve integration challenges and deliver a seamless client experience. This is an in-person role based in Chennai, India, and reports to the Implementation Manager.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Implementation team delivers and supports a broad range of integrations for ambulatory clients. Team members manage a portfolio of new interface builds, coordinate implementation activities, support issue resolution, and identify workflow gaps that could affect delivery quality, timelines, or the client experience.
  
  
The team collaborates closely with interface vendors and client stakeholders to clarify requirements, validate solutions, and support smooth, successful implementations. It also partners with athenahealth teams in the United States—including Customer Succes Manager(CSM), Project Manager (PM), and the Client Support Center (CSC)—to align priorities and resolve integration-related issues. Familiarity with ambulatory or hospital workflows and healthcare information systems is advantageous when addressing complex technical and operational requirements.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Design, build, configure, test, implement, and support healthcare interfaces for ambulatory client implementations.
* Investigate and resolve complex integration issues involving HL7 messaging, interface engines, networking protocols, VPN connections, SSH, SFTP, and XML-based data exchanges.
* Manage and prioritize a portfolio of interface implementation projects to meet established quality standards, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate requirements gathering, solution validation, and testing activities with clients, interface vendors, and internal cross-functional teams.
* Assess ambulatory and hospital workflows, identify integration gaps and dependencies, and recommend improvements that strengthen implementation outcomes.
* Validate end-to-end interface functionality through structured testing, defect reproduction, root-cause analysis, and resolution tracking.
* Create and maintain clear, accurate documentation of technical requirements, interface configurations, testing results, implementation decisions, and project status.
* Collaborate effectively with U.S.-based teams, internal stakeholders, clients, and vendors to align priorities, address risks, and ensure successful implementation delivery.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Support process improvement initiatives that enhance the quality, efficiency, and consistency of interface implementation delivery.
* Share technical knowledge, implementation best practices, and lessons learned from completed interface projects with team members.
* Participate in client and stakeholder meetings to clarify technical requirements, communicate implementation status, and address interface-related questions.
* Develop and maintain training materials, implementation templates, and technical reference documentation to support team readiness and knowledge transfer.
* Maintain accurate and consistent interface documentation, project records, and status updates across implementation tracking tools.
* Proactively identify and escalate implementation risks, technical blockers, and dependencies to support timely resolution.
* Review interface-related defects, coordinate corrective actions, and support post-go-live follow-up to promote solution stability.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen interface support practices, implementation workflows, and overall service quality.

**Expected Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Science, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline.
* 4+ years’ of overall experience in technical support, operations, information technology, and/or the U.S. healthcare industry.
* At least one year of project management experience, including responsibility for technical projects with significant cross-functional dependencies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with geographically distributed teams across India and the United States.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly, collaborate with relevant stakeholders, and drive problems through resolution.
* Excellent logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with a demonstrated commitment to continuously expanding technical knowledge and skills.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across teams to achieve high-quality, timely outcomes.
* Curious, creative, and proactive approach to learning, analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Willingness and ability to work during U.S. business hours (5:30 p.m.–2:30 a.m. IST).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the healthcare domain, including healthcare interfaces and interface engine technologies.
* Working knowledge of HL7 standards and healthcare data exchange concepts.
* Understanding of patient safety principles and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) requirements.
* Clinical experience or familiarity with clinical workflows.
* Certification in an Electronic Medical Record (EMR) platform.
* Working knowledge of SQL, including an understanding of database schemas and relational tables.

**About Athenahealth**
***Our vision:***
*In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*
***Our company culture:***
*Our talented*
*employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. *Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*
**What We Can Do For You**
*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative*
*workspaces*
—
*some offices even welcome dogs.*
*We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,*
*full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth*

*employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.*

We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*

**feasibility and pre-concept studies, concept and detailed design, tender and construction documentation, construction-stage support, testing and commissioning, independent inspections, audits, modernisation, and asset advisory**
.

Our portfolio includes
**high-rise and supertall towers, residential, commercial, mixed-use, hospitality, healthcare, aviation, transport, retail, sports, education, and cultural developments**

title: System Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Verantwortlich für die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit.Unterliegt der direkten Betriebsaufsicht/vorgeschriebenen Arbeitsanweisungen/Systemprüfungen.Arbeitet in einem genau definierten betrieblichen Framework.Es gibt im Allgemeinen eine schrittweise Abfolge von operativen Standardaufgaben, die befolgt werden müssen, um ein Endergebnis zu erzielen.
  
  
**Job Description**

Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile: Business Analyst – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a functional and techno-functional Business Analyst with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking. The role focuses on requirements management, solution mapping, process modelling, data analysis, integration and API requirements, interface specifications, and banking data structures across Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role Business Analyst – Finacle Core Banking**
**Experience 5+ years in banking; 3+ years in business analysis**
**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Business Analyst in banking transformation projects.
* Conduct requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions with business and technology teams.
* Gather, analyze, document and validate business, functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents and test scenarios.
* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.

title: Senior Manager, Veeva RIM Integration Manager
description:
**Role Summary:**
 At Pfizer we make medicines and vaccines that change patients' lives with a global reach of over 780 million patients.
   

  

 Within Digital R\&D Creation Center, the Veeva RIM team is responsible for defining the strategy and leading the delivery of the Veeva RIM product suite to end users. This includes the operation, implementation, and integration of Veeva RIM solutions that address R\&D business processes effectively. At Pfizer, Veeva RIM product suite includes all modules including Registrations, HA Correspondence, Submissions \& Publishing.
   

  

 The Snr Manager, Veeva RIM Integration Manager, is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for coordinating release readiness and lifecycle management for a complex portfolio of 60\+ upstream and downstream integrations supporting Pfizer’s Veeva RIM product suite. This role combines project management, stakeholder communication, and technical integration understanding, including knowledge of the Veeva RIM data model and how data model changes impact integrations and consuming systems. The role works closely with Product Management, Business Owners, Business Process Owners, Regulatory Operations, technical teams, Quality, validation partners, integration owners, consuming application teams, and vendors to manage release impacts, data model changes, remediation needs, cutover readiness, and operational handoffs in alignment with Agile, SDLC methodologies.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities:**
**Integration Portfolio and Project Management**
* Accountable for coordinating visibility, readiness tracking, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment across a portfolio of 60\+ upstream and downstream Veeva RIM integrations spanning consuming systems, business processes, data flows, and stakeholder groups.
* Serve on a SAFe Agile team and contribute to PI planning, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and management of Veeva RIM release impacts, dependencies, risks, issues, readiness status, cutover activities, and operational handoffs across the integration landscape.
* Accountable for ensuring downstream consumers, upstream source systems, and Business Process Owners have clear awareness of upcoming release scope, timing, data model changes, process impacts, testing expectations, cutover needs, and required actions.
* Accountable for developing and managing release communications, Business Process Owner updates, consumer impact summaries, readiness checkpoints, escalation messages, and post\-release follow\-up.
* Accountable for tracking timelines, milestones, dependencies, action items, decisions, and stakeholder status reporting to keep integration work aligned to Veeva RIM release commitments.


**Technical Integration and Remediation Coordination**
* Accountable for coordinating with integration owners, consuming application teams, technical leads, platform teams, and vendors to ensure technical issues, root causes, remediation plans, and readiness risks are visible and actively tracked.
* Apply practical understanding of the Veeva RIM data model, APIs, middleware, ETL patterns, file\-based integrations, SSO, data mapping, data model impacts, error handling, monitoring, and operational support to coordinate technical discussions and decisions.
* Accountable for facilitating alignment with technical teams responsible for remediating impacted consuming systems to confirm readiness, track remediation progress, resolve dependencies, and support smooth cutover for Veeva RIM data model or integration changes.
* Technical design and remediation activities are performed by the accountable technical teams; this role coordinates impact assessment, readiness tracking, communications, and cutover alignment across those teams.


**Testing, Validation, and Operational Readiness**
* Accountable for coordinating functional, integration, regression, user acceptance, cutover, and operational readiness testing across impacted systems and consumers.
* Partner with Quality, validation, testing, engineering, consumer teams, and vendors to ensure integration changes meet SDLC and CSV expectations, including requirements traceability, test evidence, defect management, and release approvals.
* Accountable for maintaining key integration and release materials, such as integration inventories, consumer impact matrices, interface specifications, data flow diagrams, release checklists, runbooks, decision logs, environment matrix and support handoff materials.


**Basic Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, with 7\+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience supporting integration delivery for enterprise platforms; experience with Veeva Vault and/or Veeva RIM integrations is strongly preferred.
* Experience coordinating complex integration work across upstream systems, downstream consumers, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholder groups.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, risk/issue management, release readiness tracking, and stakeholder status reporting.
* Strong communications skills, including the ability to create clear release communications, Business Process Owner updates, consumer impact summaries, readiness updates, escalation messages, and executive\-ready status updates.
* Practical understanding of the Veeva RIM data model and integration concepts, including APIs, middleware, ETL patterns, file\-based integrations, SSO, data mapping, data model impacts, error handling, monitoring, remediation coordination, and operational support.
* Experience with Agile delivery, SDLC controls, release governance in a regulated environment.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience supporting Regulatory business processes and/or working in the Life Sciences industry.
* Experience with SAFe, Scrum, or formal project management practices; relevant certification such as SAFe, Scrum, PMP, or similar is a plus.

title: Learning & Improvement HSE
description:
**Vestas is a top company in wind technology and a driving\-force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of Wind Turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**
**People \& Culture \> Global Health, Safety \& Environment \> Systems \& Risk**
 Global HSE Systems \& Risk is Vestas' global center of expertise for HSE governance, critical risk management, management systems, compliance, organizational learning, analytics and digital enablement. We partner with leaders across the business to reinforce critical risk controls, support continuous improvement, ensure regulatory and management system compliance, and leverage data\-driven insights to improve HSE performance globally
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support the continual improvement of Vestas' HSE Management System by supporting organizational learning, knowledge sharing and improvement initiatives across the business
* You will analyze incidents, investigations, assurance findings and performance trends to identify systemic issues and improvement opportunities, develop learning products and communications, support global learning campaigns, and contribute to HSEMS improvement projects and change initiatives
* Working across regions and functions, you will help transform insights and lessons learned into practical actions that improve risk management, improve system effectiveness and enhance HSE performance globally


**Qualifications**
* Degree qualification in Occupational Health \& Safety, Human Factors, Organizational Psychology, Risk Management, Engineering, Business Improvement or a related discipline
* Min 5 years of Experience in organizational learning, incident investigation, continuous improvement, HSE management systems, risk management or operational excellence
* Understanding of incident investigation methodologies, root cause analysis, organisational learning principles and continuous improvement processes
* Experience developing communications, learning materials, awareness campaigns or change initiatives
* Knowledge of ISO management systems, assurance frameworks and HSE governance processes
* Experience in renewable energy, construction, manufacturing, utilities, mining, oil \& gas or other high\-risk industries


**Competencies**
* Demonstrated analytical capability with the ability to identify trends, themes, systemic issues and improvement opportunities from diverse information sources
* Solid written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex information into engaging and practical learning products
* Ability to facilitate learning discussions and engage stakeholders across cultures, functions and organizational levels
* Solid continuous improvement mindset with experience leading change and supporting adoption
* Ability to develop compelling improvement recommendations and contribute to business cases for HSEMS and risk management improvements
* Solid stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical delivery and execution
* Creative and innovative approach to organizational learning, communications and engagement
* Process development and technical writing


**What We Offer**
 You’ll have the opportunity to help improve Vestas’s standing in a key market for the company with promising perspectives of growth. Join Vestas and you’ll cultivate your career in an inspiring environment at the premier wind turbine producer, which has an ongoing dedication to sustainability. We value individual initiative, a readiness to accept responsibility, and the right balance of creativity and quality in every solution. At Vestas your achievement is our achievement.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Your primary location will be in Chennai, India Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 14th Oct2026
   

  

 Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels.
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
   

  

 With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
   

  

 Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
   

  

 To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: Associate Localization Specialist (0726-CH-133)
description:
**Do you enjoy figuring out localization problems, working with technology and helping others get things done?**
**Are you excited to build broad expertise across localization operations, tools and workflows?**
**About our Team:\-**
 GLoSS (Global Localization Solutions \& Services) is Elsevier's central localization technology and expertise service. We deliver shared infrastructure, AI\-powered translation tools, linguistic data assets, and localization expertise to teams across the business, from Journal Operations and Clinical Solutions to Marketing and Product. Launched in 2021, we've grown rapidly and work in a matrixed environment with stakeholders across functions and geographies.
   

  

 We are part of Operations and sit within the AI and Knowledge Operations department. Our team is small, high\-impact, and globally distributed. This role is based in India and reports to the Localization Solutions Manager in Amsterdam.
   

  

**About the Role:\-**
 As Associate Localization Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting GLoSS as the person who makes sure our tools run smoothly, our users are supported, and our day\-to\-day requests are handled well. You'll work closely with senior team members who own the stakeholder relationships and strategy to support a diverse range of teams across Elsevier: contributing to a small team that punches well above its size.
   

  

 You thrive working independently, communicating proactively, and using your own judgment to solve problems and move work forward. You are comfortable working across different localization tools and stages of workflows hands\-on, and have a curious learning mindset when it comes to new tools, ways of working and AI. You bring a service mindset, meaning you follow through, close loops, and take ownership of the work in your lane.
   

  

 Over time, this role can grow into a full Localization Specialist position as you deepen your expertise and expand your scope within GLoSS.
   

  

**Responsibilities:** 
 \-
   

  

* Provide day\-to\-day operational support across GLoSS tools, including our TMS, AI translation solutions, and AI voice platform
* Onboard and train new users on localization tools, workflows, and best practices
* Create and maintain process documentation, training materials, and user guides
* Troubleshoot tool and workflow issues, following up independently with stakeholders to close the loop
* Support vendor coordination and communication
* Liaise with stakeholders across a globally distributed, matrixed organization on day\-to\-day requests and questions


**Requirements:** 
 \-
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with localization workflows and at least one TMS platform
* Confident communicator in English: able to explain tools and processes clearly, guide users through onboarding, and follow up with stakeholders independently
* You take initiative, work things out independently, and use your own judgment to move work forward
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a dynamic, fast\-moving environment: you don't need everything defined before you act
* Intellectually curious and eager to learn you pick up new tools and ways of working quickly
* 2 to 3 years of experience working in localization


**Work in a way that works for you: \-**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long\-term goals.
   

  

 Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
   

  

**Working for you: \-**
**Benefits**
 At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family)
* Group Life insurance/accident policy
* Generous long\-service awards
* New Baby gift
* Subsidized food provided (applies to India\- Chennai)
* Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, Gazetted Public Holiday and Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Free Transport provided to and from the office (applies to India\-Chennai)


**About Us:** 
 \-
   

  

 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s

title: Business Process analysts
description:
**Data \& Process Analyst (Business Process Mapping) – Contract \| Chennai \| On\-site** 




  





**About PTS Consulting** 




  





 PTS Consulting LLP is a boutique advisory firm in Chennai. We work with corporate clients on IT Services, Business process management and data\-protection and Security (DPDP) readiness. We are growing our delivery team for an enterprise\-scale process documentation programme. We are looking for two experienced analysts who enjoy working directly with business teams.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 You will work with business stakeholders to understand how processes run today. You will turn those conversations into clear, structured process documentation that client leadership can review and sign off. The work is hands\-on and client\-facing, and you will need to be comfortable leading discussions.
 



  





**Engagement:** 
 3\-month contract, with possible extension based on programme outcomes
 



  





**Openings:** 
 2
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai, on\-site (work from office)
 



**Experience:** 
 4–8 years
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Engage with business heads and process owners across functions to understand current\-state processes
* Plan and facilitate process discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews
* Produce high\-quality business process maps, including SIPOC, swimlane diagrams, decision points and exception flows
* Write the supporting process documentation, covering process steps, roles, inputs and outputs, systems used and escalation paths
* Capture data and information flows within processes, including where data is collected, stored, shared and retained
* Validate documented processes with stakeholders and incorporate their feedback
* Keep documentation accurate, consistent and traceable to the information gathered in workshops
* Work with the wider PTS team to meet deliverable timelines and quality standards



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 4–8 years of experience, with a substantial part of it spent doing business process analysis or mapping as a core responsibility
* A background in consulting, process excellence, operations or transformation, shared services, or business analysis with a process focus
* Proven experience running stakeholder workshops and structured interviews
* Fluency in process notation and tools such as BPMN, SIPOC, swimlanes and flowcharts (Visio, Lucidchart, draw.io or similar)
* Strong written communication. You should be able to produce documentation that reads as cleanly as a well\-written BRD.
* Confidence engaging with senior business stakeholders, with a professional and diplomatic style
* Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking facts against source information



**Good to Have** 



* Exposure to multi\-function or multi\-entity corporate environments
* Familiarity with data\-protection concepts (DPDPA / GDPR) or data mapping
* Experience with Lean / Six Sigma or process improvement methods
* Proficiency in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel



**Why Join Us** 



* Hands\-on exposure to a large, multi\-function process documentation programme
* Close collaboration with senior consultants and a partner\-led team
* A contract that can be extended for strong performers

title: Process & Requirements Analyst - AVP
description:
Join us as a “
 **Process \& Requirements Analyst** 
 ” and help us deliver a simpler, better more balanced experience for our colleagues and leaders across the world.
   

  

 As the Process and Requirements Analyst you play a critical role in transforming the bank. You will map the ‘as\-is’ journey, work with all stakeholders to capture requirements for change, then lead agile design sprints and capture at every step of the journey, the design config requirements. Once solutions are built, you’ll validate them against the requirements, before we move into testing. You’ll then help create testing scenarios, based on your knowledge of the applied use cases and finally you’ll work with the Change and Training lead, to ensure that launch collateral connects how the new solution, addresses real business requirements.
   

  

 To be successful as a “Process \& Requirements Analyst”, you should have experience with:
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Critical Reasoning, Curiosity \& Attention to Detail: Must have strong analytical skills, be specific, tenacious, curious and quick to learn, with a focus on crystallizing requirements and problem statements. Should be proactive, ask the right questions, probe for clarity, and move at pace. You can look across requirements, connecting the dots across a broad set of requirements, to support creation of a coherent design solution.
* Requirements Documentation: Systematically analyzes and documents existing processes, requirements, current \& future state processes and design workshop outputs, with a high degree of specificity.
* Process Mapping: Experienced and skilled in many process mapping tools e.g., Blueworks, Visio, MSOffice etc.
* Ability to work in dynamic, fast paced, agile environment. You are a really fast learner, understanding different information quickly, assimilating new information and being able to represent that clearly and coherently, in a manner that others, not involved, can understand.
* You are solutions oriented, credible with colleagues, People Leaders and senior leaders able to work across centres of excellence, colleague support, HR tech and the journey experience team, creating one coherent, aligned set of requirements and designs.
* JIRA \& Governance: Responsible for loading requirements into JIRA and maintaining governance around and version control in the Jira, supporting design, build and testing. 5
* Test Scenario Writing: Writes test scripts for both positive and negative scenarios, ensuring independence and thoroughness in testing. 6


**Additional Skills**
* Business English \& Multinational Experience: Must be highly experienced in writing detailed specifications in business English and working in multinational environments.


**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree
* This role will be based out of Chennai and Pune.
* Core hours for this role are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST, with flexibility required for key afternoon meetings. There is a policy to attend the office 3 days in a week on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of every week.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
 Solution Engineer
   

  

 What We Need
   

  

 Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross\-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
 **Reports to:** 
 Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
   

  

**About Corpay Cross\-Border**
 Corpay Cross\-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
   

  

 As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product\-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross\-border.
   

  

 How We Work
   

  

 As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
   

  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training


 Role Overview
   

  

 As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross\-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
   

  

 The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
   

  

 You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad\-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
   

  

 The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
   

  

 Role Responsibilities
   

  

**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
 Client Implementation \& Solutioning
   

  

* Support end\-to\-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go\-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post\-go\-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.


 Technical Analysis \& Troubleshooting
   

  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.


 Global Team \& Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.


 Special Projects, Automation \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Support special and ad\-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client\-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client\-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, file\-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad\-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.


 Benefits \& Perks
   

  

* Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Medical \& Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* Wellness \& Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check\-ups for self and family.
* Tech \& Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commute \& Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.
* Culture \& Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.


**About Corpay**
**About Corpay**
 Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.

Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.

title: Information Architect
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets – with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.
   

  

* Define, govern, and continuously enhance enterprise content models, information architecture standards, authoring guidelines, and metadata frameworks across Technical Publications and Knowledge Services.
* Design and manage taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, content classifications, and metadata structures,
* Drive content reuse strategy, governance, measurement, and optimization across product divisions through content audits, reuse frameworks, standards, and metrics.
* Establish and maintain content governance processes, quality standards, style guides, authoring best practices, and review frameworks to ensure consistency and compliance across all documentation.
* Partner with Technical Publications, Systems, Product Support, Engineering, and Knowledge Management teams to align content structures with business, customer, and operational needs.
* Lead initiatives that transform technical documentation into AI\-ready, machine\-readable, metadata\-rich content capable of supporting semantic search, content intelligence, knowledge graphs, automation, and future AI applications.
* Define requirements and collaborate on the evolution of content delivery platforms, CCMS, search experiences, content reuse services, and digital knowledge ecosystems.
* Develop and track content architecture KPIs including reuse, content quality, metadata completeness, taxonomy adoption, AI readiness, and content maturity metrics.
* Facilitate governance councils, best\-practice forums, training programs, and stakeholder workshops to drive organizational adoption of information architecture standards and content strategy.
* Create and execute the roadmap toward a unified, AI\-ready knowledge ecosystem through content architecture modernization, semantic enablement, automation, content governance, and scalable knowledge delivery.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Information Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Knowledge Management, or a related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in Information Architecture, Content Strategy, Technical Documentation, or Knowledge Management.
* Proven expertise in content modeling, metadata, taxonomy, controlled vocabularies, and information architecture.
* Strong knowledge of structured authoring, XML/DITA, content reuse, and content governance.
* Experience with CCMS platforms, metadata\-driven publishing, and digital content delivery solutions.
* Strong analytical skills with experience defining content metrics, KPIs, and governance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable content and information architecture solutions.
* Experience leading cross\-functional content, process, and technology transformation initiatives.


**About KLA**
 We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
   

  

**Use of AI Statement**
 At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

 In aviation, clarity is safety.  The ePlane Company is at the forefront of India's urban air mobility revolution. Incubated at IIT Madras, we are a deep\-tech startup dedicated to designing and building the world's most compact electric flying taxi. Our mission is to make door\-to\-door flying a reality, drastically reducing commute times and decongesting our cities for a cleaner, greener future. We're a passionate team of engineers, designers, and visionaries working on cutting\-edge technology, and we're looking for brilliant minds to help us take flight.

 Enforce documentation standards, templates, and style guides across all materials to ensure a consistent and professional output.

**2\+ years** 
 of professional experience as a technical writer, technical editor, or documentation specialist in an engineering or software development environment.

 Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, English, Engineering, or a related field.

 A superior command of the English language, with impeccable grammar, spelling, and a talent for explaining complex topics in a clear and concise manner.
* **Technical Aptitude:** 
 A proven ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts related to software, electronics, and integrated systems.
* **Tool Proficiency:** 
 High proficiency with industry\-standard documentation tools, including the Microsoft Office Suite (especially Word, Excel, and Visio).
* **Attention to Detail:** 
 A meticulous and organized approach, with a keen eye for detail in formatting, consistency, and accuracy.



  




**Preferred Qualifications (Good\-to\-Haves)**

**Direct experience creating technical documentation in the aviation or aerospace industry is a significant advantage.**

 Familiarity with aerospace documentation principles and specifications such as
 **ASD\-STE100 (Simplified Technical English)** 
 ,
 **S1000D** 
 , or
 **ATA iSpec 2200** 
 .
* **Certification Documentation:** 
 Experience contributing to documentation packages for certification to standards like
 **DO\-178C, DO\-254, or ARP4754A** 
 is a major plus.
* **Relevant Experience:** 
 Experience managing engineering documents within a
 **Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)** 
 system (like Teamcenter or Windchill) or a dedicated
 **Engineering Document Management System (EDMS)** 
 .
* **Advanced Authoring Tools:** 
 Experience with dedicated technical authoring tools like
 **Adobe FrameMaker, MadCap Flare, or similar** 
 .
* **Collaboration Tools:** 
 Experience using collaborative platforms like
 **Confluence and Jira** 
 for documentation management.
* **Graphics Skills:** 
 Ability to create or edit technical illustrations, diagrams, and flowcharts to supplement written content.



  

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  

**What We Offer**
* The opportunity to work on a groundbreaking product that will redefine urban transportation.

description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid Technology Specialist role focuses on designing implementing and optimizing accessibility solutions for life and annuities insurance platforms using NVDA JAWS remediation services and HTML. The specialist will collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure digital experiences meet accessibility standards and deliver inclusive customer journeys in a day shift environment without travel requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive implementation of accessibility features across life and annuities insurance platforms using NVDA JAWS and HTML to deliver inclusive digital experiences that meet enterprise accessibility goals.
* Ensure comprehensive screen reader compatibility by analyzing user flows with NVDA and JAWS and recommending targeted enhancements that improve usability for customers with diverse abilities.
* Execute detailed remediation services for existing web assets and policy servicing applications by identifying accessibility gaps and applying structured fixes that align with recognized accessibility practices.
* Optimize HTML structures including headings landmarks forms and interactive elements to create robust semantic foundations that improve navigation and understanding for screen reader users.
* Conduct end to end accessibility testing on new and existing insurance journeys such as quoting onboarding servicing and claims to validate compliance and enhance overall customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate closely with product owners designers developers and testers in a hybrid work model to embed accessibility requirements into backlogs and technical specifications from early design stages.
* Provide clear documentation of accessibility findings remediation steps and best practice guidelines to support consistent adoption across multiple product teams and technology stacks.
* Advise teams on integrating accessibility checks into continuous integration workflows by defining repeatable test scenarios for NVDA JAWS and HTML validation tools.
* Monitor accessibility incident reports and customer feedback to identify recurring issues and drive data informed improvements that enhance trust and brand reputation in the insurance market.
* Support knowledge sharing by explaining accessibility concepts to peers and stakeholders and by showcasing how inclusive design practices strengthen business outcomes and social impact.
* Align daily tasks and deliverables with regulatory and industry accessibility expectations for life and annuities insurance ensuring that customer communications policy documents and portals remain usable for all.
* Coordinate with operations and support teams in day shift schedules to troubleshoot accessibility issues reported by internal users and customers and to provide timely resolution paths.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of accessibility frameworks by suggesting refinements to coding standards design patterns and testing guidelines that reinforce long term inclusivity.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate strong practical proficiency in NVDA and JAWS including configuration troubleshooting and interpretation of screen reader behaviors across different insurance workflows.
* Show advanced hands on experience in accessibility remediation services for complex web applications and documents within life and annuities insurance environments.
* Apply solid HTML skills with an emphasis on semantic markup forms tables and dynamic content handling to ensure compatibility with screen readers and other assistive technologies.
* Bring deep domain understanding of life and annuities insurance products processes and terminology enabling accurate mapping of accessibility needs to business journeys.
* Utilize effective communication and collaboration capabilities to work with cross functional stakeholders in a hybrid setup while articulating accessibility requirements in clear actionable language.
* Leverage analytical and problem solving skills to interpret accessibility test results prioritize remediation tasks and balance usability improvements with delivery timelines.
* Exhibit professional experience in hybrid work models and day shift operations with the ability to manage time independently and coordinate seamlessly with distributed teams.

title: Associate II Reg Strategy, GRS Oncology

 In this role, you will collaborate with Global Regulatory Leads and product teams on lifecycle maintenance submissions and regulatory activities. * Ensure regulatory positions and submission approaches are aligned across relevant global, regional and country stakeholders.

* Support responses to Health Authority questions by coordinating inputs, consolidating comments, checking consistency and ensuring delivery to agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Collaborate with country and regional colleagues on submission requirements, and implementation activities.
* Labeling, safety and aggregate\-report support
* Coordinate regulatory activities related to core and local labeling updates, including impact assessment, submission planning, implementation tracking and reconciliation.
* Support submission and tracking of aggregate reports, risk\-management documents and post\-authorization safety or efficacy commitments, as applicable.
* Generate Pearl reports, WWRS reports etc, in support of safety compliance report, Renewals, launches and


 health authority queries on need basis.
   

  

* Cross\-functional collaboration and team contribution
* Build effective working relationships with Global Regulatory Leads, CMC Regulatory, clinical, safety, labeling, quality, supply, commercial, publishing and country regulatory teams.
* Participate actively in project and regulatory sub\-team meetings, clearly communicate decisions and follow through on assigned actions.
* Provide activity\-based support across products based on business priorities and team capacity.
* Share knowledge, coach colleagues on established processes and contribute to a collaborative, accountable


**Key Deliverables and Success Measures**
**On\-time delivery**
 Assigned regulatory deliverables completed by agreed timelines, with early escalation of material risks.
   

  

**Quality and accuracy**
 Submission components and eAF CMC data are complete, consistent and first\-time\-right, with minimal rework.
   

  

**Compliance**
 Proper Input to safety compliance reports, maintaining activities tracker, systems and trainings,
   

  

**Stakeholder partnership**
 Clear communication, timely follow\-up and positive collaboration across global, regional and country teams.
   

  

**Continuous improvement**
 Documented contribution to process simplification, standardization, automation or reusable team tools.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in pharmacy, or life sciences, chemistry, biotechnology or a related discipline, with preferably relevant regulatory of 2 to 4 years pharmaceutical industry experience.

* Working knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory submissions and product lifecycle management.
* Experience preparing, coordinating or reviewing regulatory submission documents and maintaining regulatory data or trackers.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex global matrix environment with appropriate independence and attention to detail.
* Communication skills \- Ability to communicate complex information and analyses to a variety of scientific audiences in both verbal and written format, including to senior management.

 experience: Sales, Design, and Installation. Until now, how well someone new is trained — and how well an existing
